notes: «أبی ره» is a bare relation: the compiler's father, not completed
«عن أخیه موسی بن جعفر بن محمد» is one link under its name (rule 7); the Imam is inside the chain after «عن», so narrator (owner ruling 2)
«قال قال رسول الله» gives the Prophet as the end of the chain; he is not a link (rule 12)
